title: HouseholdMember
description: A member of a particular household and their role or affiliation.

person_id.description: The unique ID of the person.

primary.description: If this person can be a primary contact for the household.

create_date.description: The date this member was created, but could be earlier than start date given status.

start_date.description: The date this member was or will be added to this household.

expiration_date.description: The date this member was removed from the household.

status.description: The status of this household member.
